spec.title: House of quality: hostel mess
spec.aria: A QFD array for the hostel mess with rows Taste (weight 5), Speed (3) and Price (4), columns M (menu cycle) and C (counters), relationship strengths 9,1,1,9,3,3, and priority scores 60 for menu cycle and 44 for counters.
